extra_holdings.why_critical: Luxembourg is a major financial centre. This system gives the judicial authorities, the FIU, the CSSF, the tax administration and the SRE access to the holders and beneficial owners of every IBAN account and safe-deposit box held with Luxembourg credit institutions. It is central to anti-money-laundering, sanctions and intelligence work, and a foreign-compelled disclosure would expose the whole banking clientele.
